verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zoho CRM has custom views and custom modules as product entities, but only as API metadata and a pricing-page line. Nothing documents an ops user adding custom fields or building filtered, sorted, or shared views without admin involvement. missing for 10: documented UI for adding custom fields, filter and sort criteria for views, view sharing controls, evidence that non-admin ops users can do this, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Fetch the metadata of modules, fields, layouts, custom views, and related lists.
Build custom modules to hold data unique to your business.
